credits.title: Charlie vs. the Chocolate Factory
credits.overview: Years after his famous candy contest, Willy Wonka returns to his factory, where a new wave of "rotten" kids is plotting to nab a priceless chocolate bar.

credits.title: Echoes
credits.overview: The lives of two men unexpectedly intersect as they confront the lasting impact of their boarding school past, and as buried memories resurface.

credits.title: Greenland 2: Migration
credits.overview: Having found the safety of the Greenland bunker after the comet Clarke decimated the Earth, the Garrity family must now risk everything to embark on a perilous journey across the wasteland of Europe to find a new home.

credits.title: The Titan
credits.overview: On a bleak future Earth, a soldier endures a radical genetic transformation to save humanity. But his wife fears he's becoming more creature than man.

credits.title: Run
credits.overview: Synthetic organs have become a necessity and commodity after a drug-resistant disease sweeps through the UK. When Vallis, trying to raise enough money to save his very sick young son, gets double-crossed delivering an unusual package, his only mission is to get it back, or his son will die, and so will he.

credits.title: Curvature
credits.overview: Helen tries to cope with the recent death of her husband, a scientist who killed himself right when he was on the verge of successfully completing the invention of a time machine. credits.title: Love Is Thicker Than Water
credits.overview: Vida and Arthur come from vastly different backgrounds. Sensitive and touching, sometimes quirky and tragic, always uncompromisingly truthful, a fresh look how conflicting family ties challenge love in a modern day Romeo and Juliet tale.

credits.title: Love Blossoms
credits.overview: Violet is a chemist who is carrying on the legacy of her Belgian family's perfume company by recreating her late father's secret formula.

credits.title: Grimsby
credits.overview: Wrongfully accused and on the run, a top MI6 assassin joins forces with his long-lost, football hooligan brother to save the world from a sinister plot.

credits.title: Legacy
credits.overview: What do you do when the party of the year kicks you to the curb? Simple... create your own! When Sean and his friends are refused entry to the night of their year, they embark on a mission to stage a monster event, whilst at the same time taking down the opposition.

credits.title: Second Coming
credits.overview: A married, middle-class London couple are shocked when they seem to have been blessed — or cursed — with an immaculate conception.

credits.title: Resonant Frequency
credits.overview: Haunted by threatening voices from a radio, a paranoid schizophrenic descends into psychosis.

credits.title: Dead Europe
credits.overview: In Greece to scatter his father's ashes, Isaac hears of a curse that hangs over the head of his family. Dismissing the idea, his trip begins to unveil dark truths that forced his father to flee years ago.

credits.title: Blitz
credits.overview: A tough cop is dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers.
